intent: Entry point for the cluster/replication test binary: parses the same family of CLI flags as test/main.cpp and drives tpunit::Tests::run, deliberately not resetting state between tests.

objects.name: sigclean
objects.role: SIGINT handler that stops any running test servers before exiting

objects.name: log
objects.role: execs `tail -f /var/log/syslog | grep bedrock` into log.txt; not called anywhere in this file

objects.name: main
objects.role: parses args and runs the test suite (optionally repeated)

misfits.why: dead code - defined but never invoked from main; also a generic name that collides in intent with the repo's SINFO/SWARN logging macros despite doing something unrelated (execing into tail+grep)

name_fit.note: a plain main.cpp test-binary entry point.

naming_quality.note: `log` as a free-function name is generic and easily confused with actual logging.
